showcase.zh: 重复框把框里接出的东西再送回框里，一圈一圈地做，直到不再变化或者失败：框开出的是上一圈的结果，不是一开始的输入；光看说明，容易以为它只做一遍
showcase.en: the repeat frame feeds what is made inside back in, round after round, until nothing changes or it fails: what the frame opens with is the last round’s result, not the first input; from its description alone it is easy to think it runs once

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：不管要拆几层，都拆到每个等式左边只剩一个 ?-字母。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that splits until each equation has a single ?-letter on its left, however many levels it takes.

hint.zh: 框里放一个「分解」，其余交给框。
hint.en: One Decompose in the frame; the frame does the rest.

t.zh: 要拆几层，取决于规则和目标，事先不知道：接多少个「分解」，总会遇到更深的等式。
t.en: How many levels must be split depends on the rule and the goal, and is not known beforehand: however many Decompose parts are wired, a deeper equation will come.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref>：框左边开出它收到的东西，框里的元件做一圈，接回框右边的「结果」；下一圈，框开出的是这一圈的结果。如此反复，直到不再变化或者失败，送出最后一圈的结果。
t.en: A new part, the <part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref>: on its left the frame opens with what it receives; the parts inside do one round and wire back to “result” on its right; next round, it opens with this round’s result. So it goes on until nothing changes or it fails, and it gives the last round.
